stores.heading: Download the app
stores.description: OpenRed is now available on the official stores. Download it for free on Android and iOS.

about.heading: About the app
about.body: The OpenRed mobile application lets you record environmental measurements directly from your Android device. Connect your radiation and light pollution sensors to contribute to citizen science in real time.

features.heading: Features
features.measurementsDesc: Capture gamma radiation and light pollution data with your connected devices.
features.tracksDesc: Create and manage measurement tracks during your monitoring campaigns.
features.syncDesc: Your data is automatically synchronized with the OpenRed platform.
features.mapDesc: View your measurements in real time on an interactive map.
